statement: For every finite field of odd characteristic all rational O_m indecomposables and the entire split WG ring with exterior operations have an explicit terminating finite enumeration
depends_on: C:field_WG_structure; C:Om-canonical-templates coalgebra construction; ArtinIII.4.4; Sergeichuk2010 Lemma3.1
notes: Specified finite tuple/idempotent/conjugation enumeration at each dimension and minimal coefficient degree; explicit finite-field End quotients and Z/Z2 multiplicity factors; finite form and operation algorithms. Not a claim for nonfield bases.

statement: Over F3 the rational O3 module Sym2V has two equivariant symmetric form classes whose difference has exact order2 in the split ring
notes: Complete6-unit/6-form enumeration gives two3-element orbits; residual determinant proves stable nonvanishing; explicit rank12 congruence proves twice the difference is zero.
